data.one_liner: Connect to external displays via wired or wireless connections and exchange data.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps to connect to wired or wireless external displays and present a secondary view. It provides bidirectional parameter transfer between the main view and the external display view, as well as screen status monitoring.
use_when: You need to project your Flutter app content onto a secondary monitor or TV screen.
The main app and external display view need to exchange data or parameters.
avoid_when: You are targeting Windows, Linux, or Web platforms, which are not supported.
You only need basic web viewing or device info.
strengths: Supports wired and wireless external displays across Android, iOS, and macOS.
Enables bidirectional parameter passing between main view and external view.
Includes platform-specific lifecycle handling like iOS UIScene support and macOS window management.
weaknesses: Windows, Linux, and Web are not supported.
Requires manual native configuration on iOS (UIScene lifecycle) and macOS (AppDelegate setup) for full plugin compatibility.
data.setup_notes: Requires native configuration in Info.plist / AppDelegate for iOS (UIScene support) and AppDelegate for macOS if using other plugins on the external display.
